Task 1 Guide Task 2 Guide Clear Sentences

1 IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Full Breakdown

Key Takeaways:

  • Time: 20 minutes for 150+ words
  • Structure: Analyse and Plan, Introduction, Overview, Detailed Paragraphs
  • Overview is CRUCIAL: Summarise trends with NO specific data
  • Stay objective: No personal opinions, just factual reporting
  • Select key features: Don't describe everything - highlight the significant

Pro Tip

The Overview paragraph is what separates Band 6 from Band 7+. Always state the main trend or most striking feature BEFORE diving into specific numbers.

2 IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Full Breakdown

Key Takeaways:

  • Time: 40 minutes for 250+ words (worth 2/3 of Writing score)
  • 4 Paragraph Structure: Introduction, Body 1, Body 2, Conclusion
  • Plan FIRST: 5-10 minutes planning = better essay
  • Clear thesis: State your position in the introduction
  • Each criterion = 25%: Balance all four for best results

Pro Tip

Your introduction IS your essay plan. State your opinion + two reasons, then use those reasons as your Body 1 and Body 2 topic sentences. Simple!

3 How to Write Clear Sentences in English

Key Takeaways:

  • SVO Structure: Subject-Verb-Object for maximum clarity
  • Prefer Active Voice: "The team completed the project" not "The project was completed"
  • Eliminate jargon: "Use" not "Utilize", "Near" not "In close proximity to"
  • Mix sentence types: Simple, Compound, Complex, Compound-Complex
  • Read aloud: Catches awkward phrasing and unnecessary words

Pro Tip

For Band 7+, you need a MIX of sentence types. Use simple sentences for impact, complex sentences to show range. But accuracy always beats complexity - a correct simple sentence scores higher than an incorrect complex one!
